description: SCP-1176 is the mummified corpse of a human male assumed to have been of Arabian ancestry and to have died in the 10th-11th century AD. In the place of all bodily fluids that would be found in a living human being, SCP-1176 contains a fluid of viscous consistency and golden color, designated SCP-1176-1. Testing of SCP-1176-1 has found it to be chemically identical to clover honey produced by the Anatolian honey bee.
